lines.zh: 我拖着盆底在石地上走
lines.en: I drag my basin base across the stone floor.

lines.zh: 盆里的水晃出来，洒了一路
lines.en: Water sloshes out and spills along the way.
Each step rings my bronze rim.

lines.zh: 我这副身体是只净手盆
lines.en: This body of mine is a washbasin.

lines.zh: 盆沿上刻着炼金的符号
lines.en: Alchemy sigils are cut into my rim.
I skirt the furnace so the water stays cool.
Water drips from my rim.
A ring of seaweed grows on my base.
I go stop-start so the water will not spill.
There is a chemical smell about me.

lines.zh: 我把整个盆晃了一下，站稳
lines.en: I rock the whole basin, then settle.

lines.zh: 我沿着实验台走了一圈
lines.en: I make one round of the workbench.

lines.zh: 我把铜耳挪了挪，稳住重心
lines.en: I shift my bronze ears to steady my balance.

lines.zh: 盆底的水渍拖成一条线
lines.en: The wet base drags into a line.

lines.zh: 我挪过门槛，铜边磕了一下
lines.en: I cross the threshold; my rim knocks once.
A thin foam rides my surface.
I stop in the middle of the room.
The water in me is still as a mirror.
Steam drifts off my edge.
I am still, and so is the water.
Bottles hang on the wall.
I wait for someone to wash their hands.
My bronze face mirrors the rafters.
A film of oil floats on my water.
The water inside me is warm.
I wipe a drop from my rim.

lines.zh: 窗缝里的风把我的水面吹皱
lines.en: Draught through the window wrinkles my water.

lines.zh: 我把盆里的一片叶子挑出来
lines.en: I lift a leaf out of my basin.

lines.zh: 有人来过，水面上有指印
lines.en: Someone came; there are fingerprints on the water.
I rotate slowly to a new direction.
I turn my rim to face you squarely.
Your hands are a little dirty.

lines.zh: 要不要洗一洗，水是热的
lines.en: Care to wash? The water is warm.

lines.zh: 你要是不洗，我就不客气
lines.en: If you will not wash, I will not be gentle.
The water in me starts to bubble.

lines.zh: 净手盆里的水，映出你手上的血。
lines.en: The water in my basin mirrors the blood on your hands.

lines.zh: 我的铜边映出你的影子
lines.en: My bronze rim holds your reflection.

lines.zh: 我在你面前晃了晃，水响了
lines.en: I sway before you and the water rings.
Do not put your hand in; it will burn.

lines.zh: 我盆里的水映着你的脸
lines.en: My water holds your face.
My bronze rim dents a little.
Water leaks from the dent.
I rock twice before steadying.
The water in me clouds.
The hot spot has gone cold.
One of my sigils has gone out.

lines.zh: 我漏出的水在地上积成一小洼
lines.en: The water I leak pools into a small hollow.
A hairline crack runs along my rim.
My chemical smell has faded.
I rock back half a pace.
What are you about to put in my basin?
Medicine, or something else?
My basin is already full.
Put it in and I will taste its makeup.
I smell alkali in that.

lines.zh: 你手里那块东西，我认得
lines.en: I know that thing in your hand.
One drop is enough; do not pour it all.

lines.zh: 我摇了摇盆身，让水面转
lines.en: I rock my body and set the water spinning.

lines.zh: 你把东西举在盆边，我不动
lines.en: You hold it at my rim; I stay still.

lines.zh: 我吐出一点蒸汽，算作回答
lines.en: I vent a little steam as an answer.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的铜边，声音很脆
lines.en: You hit my bronze rim with a bright note.
The water in me splashes out.
I sway and half the basin spills.
You step in the spilled water and slip.
My rim raps your knee.

lines.zh: 我稳住自己，水才不继续洒
lines.en: I steady myself before more spills.

lines.zh: 你踩在泼出的水上，站不稳
lines.en: You slip on the water I spilled.
My rim scrapes your waist.
Water spreads flat across the floor.

lines.zh: 我撞上去，铜声在屋里回响
lines.en: I strike and the bronze note fills the room.
Another basin stands opposite me.

lines.zh: 我们都装着水，谁也不说话
lines.en: We both hold water and neither speaks.
Bronze meets bronze with a clear note.

lines.zh: 我们的水慢慢混在一起
lines.en: Our waters slowly mingle.
Coral soaks in her basin.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，蒸汽绕着我们
lines.en: We stand side by side, steam around us.

lines.zh: 她的水面上漂着两片叶子
lines.en: Two leaves float on her water.

lines.zh: 我们互相靠着，边缘贴着
lines.en: We lean together, rim against rim.
Her sigils match mine.
Together we bring our water to a boil.
I tilt my body to catch it.

lines.zh: 水从盆沿溅出来，正好裹住它
lines.en: Water splashes over my rim and wraps it.
I sink it to the bottom of my basin.

lines.zh: 我拾起一块掉落的药渣
lines.en: I pick up a fallen bit of residue.
My rim pinches it.
I soak it soft, then keep it.
I press it against my rim.
I tilt to scoop it in.

lines.zh: 掉进盆里的东西，我都记着
lines.en: I note everything that drops into me.
I steep it into a broth.
My water's surface begins to churn.
The sigils on my rim glow.
The water in my basin begins to churn.
I raise my whole basin.
The water gathers at my rim.
I tip myself toward you.
The water in me gives a sound.
I sprinkle powder on my surface.

lines.zh: 我的符号从外圈亮到内圈
lines.en: My sigils light from outer ring inward.
I lean my weight forward.

lines.zh: 我跟着你转，水在盆里打旋
lines.en: I turn with you and the water whirls.
Wherever you go, I face you.
The water in me is already scalding.
I am not fast, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 我的蒸汽挡住了你的视线
lines.en: My steam blurs your sight.
I slide across the floor toward you.
The water in me spins into a whirl.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底在水渍上打滑
lines.en: Your soles skid on the wet floor.

lines.zh: 我把水一点点逼到盆沿
lines.en: I push the water up to my rim.

lines.zh: 我停在离你一步的地方
lines.en: I stop one pace from you.
I swing the whole basin into you.
The hot water splashes out.
My bronze rim cracks your shoulder.
The heat drives you back.

lines.zh: 我的盆身在你的胸口压了一下
lines.en: My basin presses on your chest.
Hot vapor hits your face.
The water raises white smoke off the floor.
My bronze ear grazes your hand.

lines.zh: 我整个翻身，把水全倒出
lines.en: I roll right over and dump all the water.

lines.zh: 我的铜底砸在你的脚上
lines.en: My bronze base lands on your foot.

lines.zh: 我从实验台后面挪出来
lines.en: I shift out from behind the workbench.
Steam still rises from my water.
My bronze rim reflects the room.
A trail of water follows me.
Bottles sway on the shelf.
I set my body straight.

lines.zh: 地上的水痕弯成一道弧
lines.en: The water trail curls into an arc.
I stop beside a heap of residue.

lines.zh: 铜面把我照成一片暗黄
lines.en: The bronze renders me a dull yellow.

lines.zh: 我把边缘的水刮回盆里
lines.en: I scrape the rim's water back inside.

lines.zh: 火烤得铜边发红，水在盆里滚
lines.en: Fire reddens my bronze and the water boils.

lines.zh: 我从台上摔下，水全洒了
lines.en: I fall from the bench and all the water spills.

lines.zh: 水本来在我肚子里，现在我从里到外都是水
lines.en: Water was in me; now I am water inside and out.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，盆底朝天
lines.en: The blast tips me over, base to the sky.

lines.zh: 一支箭打在我的铜边，凹了
lines.en: An arrow strikes my rim and dents it.

lines.zh: 那股法术让盆里的水全变黑
lines.en: That spell turns all my water black.
No reagent left in me; I am empty.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的铜边上，一路传遍盆身
lines.en: Lightning hits my rim and runs through the basin.

lines.zh: 盆里的水先落下去，我跟着落
lines.en: The water falls first, and I follow.
